browser-tests/chat-scroll-overlap.spec.t: The bug is cumulative: each evict-and-rehydrate cycle pulled the list's running size average down by about a turn's height until it reached zero, so the 12 cycles are the claim, and the watch samples every row on every frame of them.

The time is the page hydrating and rendering its rows frame by frame under the per-frame watch, in a bundle that carries React's development build. It ran 8.0 to 15.4 s on main, and 15.9 to 27.2 s on a contended machine; no trim of the test brings that under the budget.

The time is the same fixture's page load, remount and row hydration under the per-frame watch. It ran 9.9 to 18.3 s on main, and 20.9 to 23.7 s when the shard's runner was slow, with every other test on that shard slower by the same ratio.
